scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run build:app
scripts.build:yandex: npm run typecheck && npm run build:yandex:app
scripts.draft:build: npm run typecheck && npm run draft:build:app
scripts.pages:build: npm run typecheck && npm run pages:build:app
scripts.pages:qa: npm run typecheck && npm run build:app && npm run pages:build:app && playwright test --config=playwright.phaser-pages.config.ts
scripts.release:check: npm run typecheck && npm run ci:check && npm run asset:smoke && npm run build:app && npm run build:yandex:app && npm run verify:yandex

scripts.candidate:build: npm run typecheck && npm run candidate:build:app
